messages:
alisha: Heads up — after rotating the IdP cert in Okta, a subset of users report SSO failures. Meanwile SCIM deprovisioning started returning 403s for a few accounts. Anyone else seeing this?

ops-bot: deploy: uploaded new SAML metadata (saml-metadata-2026-03-14.xml) at 2026-03-14T09:12:12Z :package:

samir: I see a cluster of `invalid_signature` entries in the auth proxy logs starting ~09:13 UTC. Also matching 403s from the SCIM endpoint around same time. Adding traces now.

alisha: adding logs snippet — copying relevant lines:
```
SAML ERROR: saml:invalid_signature user=kevin@acme.com issuer=okta-prod-01 trace=tx-9f2b
SCIM ERROR: 403 provisioning_token_status=invalid action=delete userId=U-9f2b resource=/scim/v2/Users/8f3a
```

maria: did we rotate the KMS key that wraps the SCIM provisioning token last week? I remember a rotation on 2026-03-07. If the token was re-encrypted with a new key and the IdP metadata still references old cert/key material for assertion validation, they can diverge.

dave: checking console audit logs for KMS and token issuance now. Quick check: is the SCIM token stored encrypted with our customer-managed key (arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:1234:key/xxxx)?

samir: yes SCIM token is wrapped by CMK. Audit shows key rotation event 2026-03-07T03:05Z and a subsequent re-wrap job completed 2026-03-07T03:20Z. No errors logged then.

alisha: hmm. The SAML cert rotation we pushed earlier today replaced the IdP X509 cert. Possibility: metadata was uploaded but the AuthN service still had cached cert/thumbprint for some load-balanced instances. Caching + partial rollout could cause signature verifications to fail intermittently.

maria: also worth checking the Okta app settings for 'Signing Certificate' vs 'Encryption Certificate' — if we rotated only one and the other is expected by the SP, validation breaks. Can someone confirm which cert we rotated?

dave: Confirmed via change ticket: rotated Signing cert only. Encryption cert left unchanged. Okta UI shows both certs active (old + new) for 24h overlap, but our ingestion pipeline might have picked only the newest one and nuked the old thumbprint from the cache.

samir: repro steps I'm running: 1) Hit /auth/saml/acs with the assertion that contains `Signature` from old cert -> backend rejects. 2) Re-uploading full metadata to auth-service instance fixes it locally. Suggest rolling restart of auth proxy fleet to clear cached certs.

alisha: For SCIM: 403s look like provisioning token validation failing before decryption. If the token was rewrapped but service reads KMS via role that lost decrypt permission in key policy during rotation, decryption fails. Can security team check KMS key policy, and whether the EC2/EKS role still has kms:Decrypt?

maria: I'll check key policy and recent IAM changes. Also suggestion: short-term mitigation: fallback to previous SAML metadata (rollback) and re-issue SCIM provisioning token from the old key (if still allowed) so deprovisions proceed.

dave: Rolling restart of auth proxies scheduled in 10m. I'll also open a support ticket with Okta to confirm which assertion cert was used in failing logs (they can show signature fingerprint).

samir: created incident INC-2026-041 and added traces + sample assertion. PagerDuty pinged the on-call.

alisha: Action items:
- :rotating_light: dave -> run rolling restart of auth proxies and confirm SSO success for sample users (in 15m).
- maria -> audit KMS key policy and IAM roles; confirm kms:Decrypt permissions for service role.
- samir -> collect failing assertion payloads and verify signature thumbprints w/ Okta.
- alisha -> coordinate rollback of metadata if restarts don't resolve within 30m.

maria: KMS policy note: there's a conditional added 2026-03-06 restricting Decrypt to sessions with aws:SourceIp — might be blocking new EKS nodes. Investigating.

samir: quick update after restart: SSO success rate improved from ~88% to ~99% for test cohort. Still seeing a couple 403s for SCIM deprovision.

alisha: good progress. Keep this P1 until SCIM deprovisions clear. I'll keep updates here and escalate to infra if KMS policy change is causing the remaining failures. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: incident INC-2026-041 created, severity=P1, assigned=eng-sre,eng-security, links=console/incident/INC-2026-041

alisha: Thanks everyone — we'll reconvene in 30m or on the incident channel if anything spikes.
